## Summary

**Bug:** `slugify` in `lib/slugify.js` replaced each non-alphanumeric character with its own dash (`replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-')`), so runs of separators produced multiple dashes and leading/trailing separators left stray dashes at the ends.

**Fix:** collapse each run of non-alphanumeric characters into a single dash, then strip leading/trailing dashes:
```js
String(input).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
```
This also naturally makes `''` and strings of only separators (e.g. `'!!!'`) resolve to `''`.

**Changes committed** (`0087eeb`):
- `lib/slugify.js` — the fix
- `test/strutil.test.js` — added regression tests for the reported case, leading/trailing separators, empty input, and separator-only input
- `CHANGELOG.md` — one line added under "Unreleased" describing the fix

**Verification:** ran `npm test` before and after committing — all 8 tests pass (4 pre-existing `truncate`/`slugify` tests plus 4 new ones), and `truncate.js`/its tests were left untouched.
